I'm a financial analyst with investment-banking experience in company valuation and corporate finance experience at Nestlé Nespresso. I'm completing an M.Sc. in Business Administration (Finance) at the University of Münster, with research in empirical asset pricing, financial markets and machine learning.

What I enjoy most is turning a business question into a clean dataset, a defensible analysis and a clear recommendation.
